metadata.methods_description: EEG data were recorded using a 64-channel BrainAmp amplifier (Brain Products GmbH, Germany) at 1,000 Hz sampling rate with online reference at FCz and ground at AFz. Stimuli (20 Japanese newspaper articles) were presented word-by-word via rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) in PsychoPy, with each word displayed for 500 ms followed by 500 ms blank screen. Preprocessing was performed using MNE-Python (v1.9.0) and Eelbrain (v0.40.3) and involved: bandpass filtering (0.1–40 Hz), independent component analysis for ocular artifact removal, common average re-referencing, epoching (−100 to 1,000 ms relative to word onset), downsampling to 200 Hz, and baseline correction using the pre-stimulus interval (−100 to 0 ms). Preprocessed data are provided in the derivatives folder.
